base_url.correction: https://global-api.afterpay.com (US/CA; region-specific: api.eu.afterpay.com, api.au.afterpay.com, api.afterpay.com for NZ) — not a single https://api.afterpay.com root

auth_type.correction: basic (HTTP Basic Auth with Merchant ID as username and Secret Key as password)

example.correction: curl example must use region host + Basic Auth + Accept header, e.g. curl -u MERCHANT_ID:SECRET_KEY -H 'Accept: application/json' https://global-api.afterpay.com/v2/configuration — bare GET https://api.afterpay.com/ is not a documented endpoint

notes: Docs live. Base URL is region-split (global-api/eu/au/nz hosts), not single api.afterpay.com. Auth is HTTP Basic (merchant ID + secret), not unknown. Rate limiting exists (headers/429) but public numeric limits not published. No free public API tier for merchants. Example curl is invalid. CORS not documented.
